svg.text: ROLE-BASED ACCESS · ENVIRONMENT-BOUND TRUST · EXPLICIT DENY PATHS
OIDC subject + audience bind role assumption
Dev deploy cannot change Performance ECS
Runner Publish has no ECS / RDS / SageMaker
JumpStart S3: List/Get · DJL ECR: pull · /aws/sagemaker/*: Logs write
ECR pull · ECS Describe* · SQS GetQueueAttributes
No RDS data access · No SageMaker InvokeEndpoint
Runner and deploy roles cannot invoke
manual account policies require separate audit
Permission graph reflects the Terraform-managed baseline; residual account policies require a separate IAM audit.
